description: This is a test script for the LightyTest module, designed to test the SCGI responder integration with lighttpd web server. The script sets up environment, runs a series of HTTP requests with various line endings and URL parameters, and checks responses.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A class for testing the lighttpd server and its SCGI responder integration.

methods.name: start_proc
methods.description: Starts the lighttpd process with a specified configuration file.

methods.name: handle_http
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request and checks the response within the test framework.
